NetSfere Enterprise is a secure messaging service and platform from Infinite Convergence Solutions, Inc. NetSfere provides the industry’s first and only quantum-proof security and message delivery capabilities, including global cloud-based service availability, device-to-device E2EE, and administrative controls for seamless communication over text, voice, and video with complete control by IT teams.

Designed to meet government regulations and industry specific challenges your organization is up against, NetSfere's next-generation approach allows employees to safely communicate business information in real-time via a user-friendly web/desktop interface or mobile messaging app, eliminating the need to use risky and non-compliant consumer-grade messaging apps for federal & local government institutions and commercial enterprises alike.

The service leverages Infinite Convergence's experience in delivering mobility solutions to tier 1 mobile operators globally. NetSfere is also compliant with global regulatory requirements, including GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2, ISO 27001, 27701, and many others. Infinite Convergence Solutions has offices in the United States, Germany, London, India and Singapore. For more information, visit www.netsfere.com.
